title: AGENTS.md

Build required features project, including muparser, keep runtime self-contained. top-level GDAL runtime DLL (libgdal-*.dll) required non-Windows dependent DLLs required runtime data directories (share/gdal, share/proj) pure-python GDAL utilities (python/osgeo_utils) embedded-python algorithms (e.g. gdal driver gpkg validate) Build gdalraster source bundled GDAL runtime. Ensure runtime loading configured gdalraster resolves bundled DLL dependencies runtime (without relying matching user-installed Rtools environment), GDAL’s embedded python can import bundled osgeo_utils (session-scoped PYTHONPATH). Verify success gdalraster::gdal_global_reg_names() returning non-empty output driver gpkg validate algorithm running end--end. runtime installs package-managed user data paths source builds target isolated library path unless explicitly overridden

what: Why gdalraster must be rebuilt from source
title: Architecture
text: C++ standardized ABI across compilers. Name mangling, vtable layout, exception unwinding, object layout differ MSVC MinGW/GCC, can drift incompatible GCC configurations. gdalraster binds GDAL’s C++ API Rcpp (C extern "C" shim), gdalraster.dll libgdal-*.dll must come ABI world. install_gdalraster() builds source bundle’s headers import library rather reusing CRAN binary (linked — statically — Rtools’ GDAL): Internally uses withr::with_makevars(), writes scoped Makevars file points R_MAKEVARS_USER environment variable duration install — compile/link flags never leak persistent configuration.

title: Architecture
text: Producing libgdal-*.dll half job; imports dozens transitive DLLs (GEOS, PROJ, Arrow’s deep tree, HDF5, …). tools/collect_dlls.sh walks full PE import tree ntldd -R, copies every dependency resolves UCRT64 prefix bundle’s bin/, fails non-Windows-system dependency remains unresolved. bundle therefore verified-closed set: external imports Windows system DLLs. title: Architecture

title: Getting Started

title: Troubleshooting
text: Windows loader resolve libgdal-*.dll one transitive dependencies. activate_gdal_runtime() fails loudly preload libgdal-*.dll fails, LoadLibrary failure surfacing library(gdalraster) usually means runtime never activated session. Activate runtime library(gdalraster) — use gdalraster.windows::load_gdalraster(), . Isolate profile effects clean subprocess: Inspect dependency tree MSYS2/Rtools shell ntldd: ntldd -R <gdal_home>/bin/libgdal-*.dll — entry resolves outside bundle outside Windows system paths indicates missing bundled DLL. list direct imports objdump -x <gdal_home>/bin/libgdal-*.dll | findstr "DLL Name". DLL can “missing” even CI verified bundle: GitHub runner images ship products install DLLs System32 (e.g. Microsoft ODBC Driver SQL Server, msodbcsql17.dll), dependency resolves CI end-user machines. build disables linkage (GDAL_USE_MSSQL_ODBC=) bundle verification rejects known non-OS System32 DLLs, import objdump output neither bundle’s bin/ Windows system DLL culprit.

what: 1) Root problem: static registration + MXE/static builds
title: gdalraster.windows
text: GDAL’s Algorithm API uses static C++ registration. Windows build states (notably specific Rtools/MXE combinations), top-level algorithm registry observed load return names. practice means gdalraster::gdal_global_reg_names() can return character(0) even GDAL present. project solves controlling GDAL build profile runtime loading path, rebuilding gdalraster known runtime.

title: gdalraster.windows
text: MinGW-w64: GCC-based Windows compiler toolchain native .exe/.dll. MSYS2: package manager + shell environment used assemble toolchains dependencies (pacman). UCRT64: MSYS2 toolchain target using Microsoft’s Universal CRT. Rtools45: Windows R package build toolchain, also UCRT-based. practical requirement keep compile/runtime toolchains compatible (MinGW/UCRT alignment) avoid C/C++ runtime ABI mismatch problems.

what: 3) Static vs dynamic linking in this repository
title: gdalraster.windows
text: runtime pieces linked statically (portability GCC runtime bits). GDAL delivered shared runtime DLL (libgdal-*.dll) transitive dependencies bundled alongside . words: project “single-file static GDAL”, self-contained runtime bundle controlled dependency closure.

what: 4) C++ ABI compatibility (why source rebuild is required)
title: gdalraster.windows
text: gdalraster binds GDAL C++ APIs via compiled code. Even headers match, ABI mismatches can break runtime binaries built incompatible compiler/runtime combinations. package installs gdalraster source bundled GDAL headers/import libs rather assuming arbitrary prebuilt binary compatible.

what: 5) Key CMake/linker flags used and why
title: gdalraster.windows

text: GDAL CLI algorithms implemented Python rather C++. example, gdal driver gpkg validate thin C++ entry point libgdal embeds CPython interpreter runtime: GDAL locates python.exe PATH, dynamically loads matching libpython DLL, calls Py_Initialize(), imports osgeo_utils.samples.validate_gpkg. osgeo_utils pure-Python package shipped GDAL’s gdal-utils distribution (swig/python/gdal-utils/ GDAL source tree). contains compiled extension modules, CPython ABI coupling — embedded interpreter version can import . runtime bundle ships package python/osgeo_utils, version-locked built GDAL tag. activate_gdal_runtime() prepends <gdal_home>/python PYTHONPATH (session-scoped; never persisted user machine environment) embedded interpreter can resolve . PYTHONPATH read Py_Initialize(), libgdal triggers lazily first use embedded-python algorithm, activation-time configuration early enough. Without , algorithms fail : Note: compiled osgeo SWIG bindings (osgeo import gdal) intentionally built bundled (BUILD_PYTHON_BINDINGS stays — Python/SWIG build environment). pin bundle single CPython version/ABI. Python-implemented validators degrade gracefully without (e.g. validate_gpkg skips tiled gridded coverage checks).
